rfm_tuples.f: Self-disclosure of severe regulatory action against revenue-generating subsidiaries. Verify via claim_evolution (does the Q1-2025 10-Q reaffirm/qualify?) and gross-margin/cost trajectory in Q1 2025 results.
rfm_tuples.M_value: REAFFIRMED_IN_STRUCTURED_DISCLOSURE across 8-K (2025-02-26), 10-K (2025-03-03), and 10-Q (2025-05-12). Q1-25 gross margin contracted 410 bps to 47.9% (vs 52.0% Q1-24); cost of revenue rose to 52.1% from 48.0% — consistent with EAR-driven sourcing cost. Revenue growth decelerated to +13.2% YoY in Q1-25 vs +40.2% FY-24.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: The single most material adverse fact in the file: ACMR's revenue-generating subsidiaries are now on the BIS Entity List, while ~99.2% of FY2024 revenue ($775.8M of $782.1M) was sourced inside mainland China and Korea. Q1-25 already shows margin compression. Honest disclosure, but the fact itself is severe; Mode A passes (disclosed), but the magnitude warrants RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE on the underlying economics.

summary: ACMR is structurally exposed: ~99% China revenue, two operating subsidiaries (ACM Shanghai, ACM Korea) added to BIS Entity List effective Dec 2, 2024, and the company's own cited Gartner forecast calls for a 23.6% YoY contraction in 2025 China-WFE spend. Disclosure quality is high (clean Big-4-affiliate audit by E&Y Hua Ming, no going-concern language, ICFR effective, sequential reaffirmation of adverse facts across 8-K/10-K/10-Q), so this is not a 'lying' name — it is a fully-disclosed structurally-impaired name. Q1-2025 actuals (filed within cutoff) already show margin compression of 410 bps and revenue deceleration from +40% to +13% YoY, consistent with the adverse-disclosure case. Yellow Mode-B flags: frequent auditor turnover (3 firms in 4 years), $91M of insider/affiliate 10b5-1 selling over 24 months, Lingang capacity-expansion milestone >14 months late, parent-vs-subsidiary cash-trap structure with planned STAR Private Offering further diluting ACMR from 81.5% to 74.1%.
